structural.note: Bare generic id 'protein' is a high-collision token (matches the 'High Protein' dietary concept and the Protein category). Name is 'protein pancake'; id should match the specific product. No name change needed.

Functional duplicate of the base. 'tortilla wrap' is parented to 'tortilla' and both claim 'wrap'/'wraps'; a soft wrap IS a tortilla. Folding the variant's distinct aliases (spinach/tomato/low carb/flatbread wrap) into the canonical 'tortilla' avoids two items competing for the same 'wrap' query. No external items reference tortilla-wrap as a parent.

cleanups.note: Generic breadcrumb token on a specific variant; steals the query from the 'breadcrumb' base. Panko keeps its panko-specific aliases.
Plural generic; belongs to 'breadcrumb' base, not panko.
Over-broad bare token 'crumbs' mis-resolves arbitrary crumb queries to panko.
Verbatim copy of the base 'english-muffin' aliases; a generic 'english muffins' query should resolve to the base, not the sourdough variant.

Generic roll alias also held by the 'bun' base; 'bread roll' should resolve to the generic 'bun', not specifically a dinner roll. dinner-roll keeps 'dinner rolls', 'parker house roll', 'pull-apart roll'.
Generic roll alias also held by the 'bun' base; belongs to the generic 'bun'.
Plural of tortilla's own parent base 'flatbread'; a 'flatbreads' query should hit the generic 'flatbread', not be pinned to tortilla.

Wrong product: garlic texas toast is garlic bread on thick sliced bread, not a bagel. This alias mis-resolves garlic-bread/texas-toast queries to a bagel. Removing it leaves garlic-bagel with no aliases, which is fine.
Wrong product entirely: a frozen pancake aliased onto a biscuit. Mis-resolves pancake queries to a biscuit. The biscuit needs no alias.
Bare 'breadsticks' collides with the Snacks item 'breadstick-snack' (which also aliases 'breadsticks'). grissini keeps 'bread sticks', 'torino breadsticks', 'italian breadsticks'.
Alias is a verbatim copy of the item's own name; pure redundancy/pollution. Keeps brazilian cheese bread / chipa / cheese puff bread.
